name: advin-provision

steps.name: snapshot-before
steps.command: HTTPS GET / probes for each pre-change Caddy host; record status, TLS subject, and first-byte time

steps.name: service-layout
steps.command: create flow system user and directories; install empty env skeleton and stopped units

steps.name: caddy-validate
steps.command: docker exec caddy caddy validate --config /etc/caddy/Caddyfile --adapter caddyfile

steps.name: caddy-reload
steps.command: docker exec caddy caddy reload --config /etc/caddy/Caddyfile --adapter caddyfile

steps.name: other-hosts-check
steps.command: HTTPS GET / probes; compare all 12 pre-change hosts status and TLS subject

steps.name: rollback-rehearsal
steps.command: restore timestamped Caddyfile backup, remove both units, reload and compare hosts; reinstall units stopped for final state

snapshot-before.detail: 12 existing non-target hosts recorded with HTTP status, TLS subject, and first-byte seconds in advin-provision-snapshot-before.json.

service-layout.detail: flow is a no-login system user; release/current, SQLite state, and mode-600 env skeleton exist; both hardened units pass systemd-analyze verify and remain inactive until T23.

other-hosts-unchanged.detail: All 12 pre-change hosts retained their HTTP status and TLS subject after Caddy reload and rollback reload; first-byte timings are recorded in the before/after evidence files.

rollback-rehearsed.detail: Timestamped backup restored, both units removed, Caddy validated/reloaded, and all 12 host checks matched; units were then reinstalled stopped as required for the final T20 state.

operational_notes: A duplicate flow-api site append was rejected by Caddy with an ambiguous-site error; the timestamped backup was immediately restored, then validated and reloaded. The backed-up Caddyfile already contained the required single flow-api block with upstream 172.20.0.1:8790 and flush_interval -1.

The Caddyfile SHA-256 recorded during read-only preflight differs from the timestamped backup SHA-256. The cause was not established. Existing-host probes matched before and after reload/rollback; the timestamped backup was retained and used for rollback.
